Identity is NOT in doubt. Verified on four criteria - name ('Nilkanth C Patil' / 'Nilkanth Patil'; note 'Nilkanth' is a distinctive first name and no competing Hyderabad cardiologist of that name appeared), specialty (interventional cardiology), hospital (AIG Hospitals Gachibowli) and city (Hyderabad) - agreeing across his OWN self-branded website (drnilkanthpatil.in, with a doctor-profile page and service pages), mfine (whose page title is literally 'Dr. Nilkanth C | Top Cardiologist in Hyderabad | AIG Hospitals'), Practo (AIG Gachibowli practice_id 1232720), Credihealth, Skedoc, Sehat, ClinicSpots and DocIndia. All of them agree on the same qualification chain (MBBS LTMMC Sion Mumbai 2003; MD Medicine 2008; DM Cardiology AIIMS New Delhi 2012) and the same special interests.

BAND = Medium, honestly, and here is exactly why it is not High: NO qualifying official source is live for him. AIG's per-doctor page is DEAD - an allowed_domains=aighospitals.com search returned https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-nilkanth-c-patil with the title '404 Page Not Found', so per the rules hospital_profile is deliberately left BLANK and no URL was constructed to replace it. No live AIG page under any of the four AIG URL families surfaced. Under the banding contract his own website is PRIMARY SELF-PUBLISHED, not official, and mfine/Practo/Credihealth/Skedoc/Sehat/ClinicSpots/DocIndia are corroborating only. The evidence is nonetheless strong and mutually consistent across eight independent publishers, so this is recorded as a usable Medium rather than downgraded - it is not an ambiguity problem, it is a dead-hospital-page problem.

EXPERIENCE FIGURE CONFLICTS - flagged for human check: his own site says 26 years overall with 15 in cardiology; Practo says 23 years. Both are recorded as stated rather than one being silently chosen. Similarly his MD is described as 'MD Internal Medicine, BMCRI Bangalore' on his own site and 'MD General Medicine, Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences 2008' on Practo - these are compatible (BMCRI is an RGUHS-affiliated college), not contradictory.

NO email or phone recorded. A targeted allowed_domains=drnilkanthpatil.in search was run specifically to find a published contact number or address on his own site; the search index returned his profile and service pages but surfaced NO phone or email verbatim, so nothing was recorded. Search summaries suggested 'visit his website for phone numbers' - that is not a verbatim value and was correctly discarded. A JustDial listing for him was returned and was DELIBERATELY REJECTED AND NOT RECORDED - JustDial numbers are call-tracking proxies, not the doctor's line. No LinkedIn profile surfaced and none was guessed. Nothing was pattern-derived.

HUMAN FOLLOW-UP WORTH DOING: drnilkanthpatil.in is his own domain and very likely carries a contact or enquiry page with a real number or form that the search index did not expose. Opening that site directly is the single highest-value next step for this row.
